items.title: What Could Constellation Energy (CEG) Gain From A 200 MW Salem Uprate?
items.summary: Constellation Energy (NasdaqGS:CEG) and PSEG Power outlined plans for a 200 MW nuclear uprate at the jointly owned Salem plant. The partners are assessing how the extra capacity at Salem could support rising power needs from data center operators. Management is also exploring direct partnerships with data center developers that could anchor long term offtake for future nuclear output. The planned 200 MW Salem uprate and data center talks are important, but investors should weigh them...
